caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by several black strings that extend upwards out of the frame. The puppet has a large, tan face with exaggerated facial features including green and brown shading, prominent eyebrows, and prominent pink lips curved into a slight smile. Its hair is black, with a section forming a single braid at the back. The puppet is dressed in loose, black clothing with red trim around the collar, cuffs, and hem, and matching black pants also featuring red trim near the ankles. The shoes are brown with rounded toes. On the right lower leg of the puppet, there are two small, light blue flower shapes. The puppet’s hands and feet are rendered to appear wooden and articulated. The marionette is positioned with one arm bent and hand raised, while the opposite leg is bent, as if in motion. To the left of the puppet, a reddish-brown ball with a small magenta patch is suspended by a single black string. The entire composition is set against an off-white background with visible spots of aging or marks. In the bottom left corner, the artist’s name "ELMER WEISS" is written in small letters.
title: Juggling Marionette
